responsibility: This file implements the C-side RTL predicate and operand-validation helpers used by NDS32 instruction recognition and expansion. It checks structural legality of complex operands such as multiple load/store PARALLELs and stack push/pop sequences, tests whether constants enable specialized instructions like bclr/bset/btgl/bitci, classifies symbolic and floating memory forms, validates target-specific CONST/UNSPEC and vector-immediate encodings, and exposes helper predicates consumed from predicates.md and backend code. It is the procedural operand-classification companion to the md-visible predicate declarations.
